description: Creator HQ production upload policy; this is NOT YouTube Studio channel settings.

bizarrePast.audienceRule: General historical documentary; review individual child-targeted exceptions

whatIf.audienceRule: General-audience positive hypothetical stories, including talking dogs; family-friendly does not mean made for kids

littleWild.audienceRule: Child-directed original animated series; keep made-for-kids true unless a genuinely different video warrants review

highlights.audienceRule: General-audience highlight commentary; review each upload for audience and copyright

notes: Audience must reflect actual individual video content; a family-friendly video is not automatically child-directed
This file cannot modify the existing YouTube Studio Upload defaults, Featured Places, channel home layout, trailer or moderation
Preserve automatic publishing set in AI Tuber and Metricool as explicitly scheduled
Do not turn off subscriber notifications globally because the referenced video oversimplifies YouTube recommendation behavior
